windows.notes: Send files from the computer to the phone: while the phone shows its files (Show my files), use Send files to… on the computer or drop files and folders on its window. They go into the folder open there, or the phone's Download folder. Files the phone has already are never replaced without asking.

macos.notes: When a file isn't backed up, ucopy now says which one and why: in History on the phone and the computer, on the phone's job card and notification, and in alert emails. Copying phone files to the clipboard tries again when another program is holding the clipboard.
